baseline_notes.description: Shared prestretch from a 200 mm relaxed loop on the fixture placement; physical finite-strain relaxation, no playback or trajectory scaling
baseline_notes.static_props: Common wood finish, end-grain scale and window exposure for all six captures; object initial poses shared.
baseline_notes.friction_note: The stronger-pull baseline uses wood sliding friction 0.20 (assumed), limiting the energy-based stopping distance inside the guide; independent friction edit is x2 to 0.40.
baseline_notes.add_preset_note: Source-absent stopper preset centered at x=15 mm, allowing about 44.5 mm return before impact. No existing object is moved by an edit.

physics_scope: finite-strain closed viscoelastic shell; identical two-branch material relaxation in membrane and bending; native frictional rigid-flex contact; guided prismatic wood
source_assets: Reused licensed BlenderKit geometry and CC0 scanned PBR/HDRI; preserve original attribution
constitutive_model: Objective membrane/bending Maxwell law; native wooden-pin/slider collision filtering for the long path; completed-step midpoint constraint work is a diagnostic and does not change forces.

boundary_conditions.left: finite material arc fixed to world
boundary_conditions.right: finite material arc rigidly bound to slider
boundary_conditions.refinement: tangent points and fixed material intervals coincide for n128/n160/n192

native_origin: the solves of the registered increment, with these physical parameters and the fixed material boundary; the visible clamp, camera and appearance are shared by all cases
